name: MAG
recent: MAG Holdings Berhad 近期出现董事及大股东 Ng Min Lin 在闭门期内的持股变动与交易意向申报，同时市场新闻指出公司 2026 年上半年净利同比下滑 48.4% 至 1330 万令吉，主要受物流成本与汇率波动影响。此外，公司最新财报显示 2025 财年录得净亏损 2.398 亿令吉，营收环比下降 15.1%。
notable: 执行主席 Ng Min Lin 于 2026 年 8 月 17 日在闭门期内以每股 0.160 令吉增持 255 万股。
公司发布 2026 年上半年业绩，净利同比下滑 48.4% 至 1330 万令吉。
Ng Min Lin 于 2026 年 10 月 22 日及 10 月 24 日申报在闭门期内交易公司证券的意向。
risks: 2025 财年录得净亏损 2.398 亿令吉，净利率为 -236.2%。
2026 年上半年净利同比大幅下滑 48.4%，受物流成本与汇率波动挤压。
董事及大股东在闭门期内有交易意向及实际增持，需留意后续股权变动。
earnings: 2025 财年营收为 1.015 亿令吉，环比下降 15.1%；净亏损 2.398 亿令吉，净利率 -236.2%，而上一期净利率为 8.3%。

recent_en: MAG Holdings Berhad recently saw director and substantial shareholder Ng Min Lin's interest changes and intention to deal during closed periods, while news reported 1H26 net profit plunged 48.4% to RM13.3 million due to logistics costs and forex volatility. The latest financials show a FY2025 net loss of RM239.8 million with revenue down 15.1% QoQ.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Ng Min Lin acquired 2.55 million shares at RM0.160 per share during closed period on 17 Aug 2026.
The company reported 1H26 net profit down 48.4% YoY to RM13.3 million.
Ng Min Lin notified intention to deal in company securities during closed periods on 22 Oct 2026 and 24 Oct 2026.
risks_en: FY2025 recorded a net loss of RM239.8 million with a net margin of -236.2%.
1H26 net profit fell 48.4% YoY, squeezed by logistics costs and forex volatility.
Directors and substantial shareholder have intentions to deal and actually acquired shares during closed periods; monitor subsequent shareholding changes.
earnings_en: FY2025 revenue was RM101.5 million, down 15.1% QoQ; net loss was RM239.8 million with a net margin of -236.2%, versus prior net margin of 8.3%.
